item5_instrumentCoverage_done.selfCorrectionDuringBuild: the first version of deployedJobNamesIn() only matched a literal job name after `gcloud run jobs deploy`. Running it live against real project state immediately surfaced 5 false positives (factory-bastrop-publish, factory-dollar-fields-patch, factory-publish-migrate, factory-staging-reset, factory-verify-walk) -- all five are deployed by cloudbuild.publish.yaml's `for JOB in name1 name2 ...; do gcloud run jobs deploy "$$JOB" ...; done` loop, a shell-variable indirection the simple regex could not resolve. Fixed by resolving `deploy "$$JOB"` against an earlier `for JOB in ...; do` on the same file, mirroring the sibling instrument's own resolution of `--args=$$ARGS`. This is exactly DEV_PROCESS 2.2 in action: the check was tested against real state before being trusted, and it failed for the RIGHT reason (a real parsing gap), not the wrong one.
